blocks.text: Arnold Schwarzenegger is returning to the Christmas genre after 30 years, this time taking on the role of Santa Claus in the upcoming holiday heist film “The Man with the Bag.” Schwarzenegger last starred in a Christmas genre film in 1996 with “Jingle All the Way,” a Christmas family comedy. In “The Man with the Bag,” Schwarzenegger stars as Santa, whose iconic red bag is stolen by a rogue elf with a grudge, played by Awkwafina. With Christmas at risk, Santa turns to a thief from his “Naughty List,” played by Alan Ritchson, to help recover the stolen bag. Ritchson’s character […]...
